title: Sustainability and systems thinking in the chemistry of aspirin manufacture for first-year engineering students

The activity has pre-class preparation, collaborative role-play, and post-activity reflection. It fostered systems thinking and trade-off analysis in alignment with sustainability goals which were limited prior to the intervention.
